title: Other Work Orders settings save as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Switch "Require Review Before Completion" on.
  3. Click Save settings.
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The tab opens.

Step 2:

  • The toggle shows on.

Step 3:

  • The settings are saved, with no window and no message about Internal Work Orders.

Step 4:

  • "Require Review Before Completion" is on and "Internal Work Orders" is still off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
